title: Leisure & lists
lead: Books, films, places, purchases you are still thinking about, and things to do one day.
emptyHint: Save a film, a book, a place or an idea for an evening.

fields.title: What is it
fields.tagsHint: Your own words. Type one and press Enter.
fields.ownershipHint: Kept separate from how far through it you are, so “mine, unread” is a real answer.
fields.budgetHint: A number you typed. Nothing is looked up and no price is tracked.

suggest.title: What suits right now?
suggest.lead: Tell it roughly where you are and it offers one thing.
suggest.nothing: Nothing on your list fits that
suggest.nothingHint: Rather than offering something that doesn't, it offers nothing.
suggest.busyHint: You said you're swamped, so nothing is being suggested.
suggest.noAi: This is a short set of rules, not a recommendation engine. Nothing is sent anywhere.

actions.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from your list.

missing: This is not on your lists
missingHint: It may have been deleted, or the link may be out of date.
makeTripHint: Nothing is created automatically — you choose what the trip is and when.

book.title: No books saved yet
book.hint: Add one you want to read, or one already on your shelf.

movie.title: No films or series yet
movie.hint: Save something you want to watch, or something you have just finished.

destination.title: No places yet
destination.hint: Save somewhere you want to go, or somewhere worth going back to.

future_purchase.title: Nothing being researched
future_purchase.hint: Save something you have looked into, so you don't start from scratch next year.

idea.title: No ideas yet
idea.hint: Save something to do one evening, one weekend, or one day.
